LESSON: KUSOMA 3.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA TAMTHILIA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: DHIKI ZINAZOKUMBA WANYAMA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli
Topic 3.2: Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya tamthilia ili kuipambanua
2. kujadili sifa za tamthilia kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya tamthilia ili kuipambanua
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya tamthilia ili kuipambanua. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili sifa za tamthilia kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili sifa za tamthilia kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya tamthilia ili kuipambanua

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya tamthilia ili kuipambanua
2. kujadili sifa za tamthilia kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
